inputDoc: State-driven bot (scripts/export-fixtures.ts makeBossBot, adapted from act1.test.ts makeWeaponBot): walks in, then 180-tick cycles of 60 % attacking (sword at 2.3 u / bow at 6 u, FIRE held, aimed at the boss) and 40 % dodging (strafe, ROLL 1/45 per tick), SWAP between sword and bow every 600 fight ticks, flask at <= 2 half hearts, Ember at <= 1, DEBUG_BOSS (J, 10 % of the boss hp, never skipping a phase) once per 240 fight ticks. No god mode. The recording is authoritative.
